# Test fixtures

`RiggedFigure.glb` is the "Rigged Figure" model from
[KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/RiggedFigure)
(commit `edc7c9e67c639d230715049ee31f9a96a6babbbe`), © Cesium, licensed
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). It is unmodified. The Blender
integration test converts it because it is small (50 KB) and has a skin and an animation.
